name: Semantic Polar Demands
description: Replaces the algebraic equation $\tau = c(2s_u - 1)$ with a semantic description of "preferred phase" and "stabilizing/destructive resonance". The interlock shatters if both feeds are destructive. This removes the direct closed-form equation that models previously matched to standard 2-SAT templates, forcing them to deduce the logical structure from the text.
